text:
Theo Ramos: Hi team, couple of odd onboarding things I hoped you could help with: 1) I waived benefits during orientation but my spouses COBRA from his old employer ends 07/20  can I still enroll outside the 30-day window and add him? 2) I moved states recently (from CA to NY) and my state tax withholding still shows CA on the payroll preview. 3) I submitted a home office equipment reimbursement request and its marked pending. Who do I ping for each?

Ava (People Ops): Welcome Theo! Short answers: 1) loss of other coverage is a QLE so you can enroll and add spouse (upload proof of COBRA end date). 2) state tax must be updated in Workday and payroll needs the residency change to run properly. 3) home office reimbursements are reviewed by People Ops and paid via payroll once approved. Tagging Sanya, Liam, and Rita.

Theo Ramos: Thanks Ava. I can upload the COBRA termination letter  it says coverage ends 07/20. If I enroll will coverage be effective 07/21 or back to 07/20?

Sanya (Benefits): QLE for loss of coverage usually allows enrollment effective retro to the loss date or the date you enroll within the 30-day window depending on carrier. Upload the COBRA termination letter to BambooHR and put "QLE - spouse loss" in the note. Ill request the carrier to set effective 07/20.

Theo Ramos: Done  uploaded "Ramos_Maria_COBRA_end_072024.pdf" and added the note.

OnboardBot: Document "Ramos_Maria_COBRA_end_072024.pdf" received and linked to ticket B-2277.

Sanya (Benefits): Got it. Ill push the QLE enrollment through. If carrier accepts retro effective 07/20 payroll will do a retro deduction for premiums if needed.

Theo Ramos: Great. About state taxes  I updated my address in Workday on 07/10 but payroll preview still shows CA. I moved to Brooklyn on 07/05 and filled the NY state tax form.

Liam (Payroll): State tax updates require the state withholding form in Workday + proof of residency in some cases. I dont see NY form in your record; did you submit IT-2104 or the equivalent? If you did, might be after the payroll cutoff. If you DM me your employee ID Ill force the update for the next run.

Theo Ramos: I filled out the NY IT-2104 online via Workday but maybe hit submit after cutoff. DMing employee ID now.

Liam (Payroll): Thanks. I see the NY form effective 07/11  I'll apply it for the 07/15 payroll. If there are CA withholdings to reverse, we can correct them on the next cycle but state reciprocity rules may apply. Also, if you had CA tax withheld and should've had NY, you may need to file a part-year return. Rita can advise on compliance.

Rita (HR Compliance): Quick note on state taxes: moving mid-year can create dual withholdings. We advise keeping records of move date and updating withholding ASAP. If you need an employer letter for tax filings I can generate one once payroll finalizes.

Theo Ramos: Helpful, thank you. Finally, the home office reimbursement  I submitted $420 for a monitor and stand on 07/08 and the portal says Pending Approval. Any ETA?

Ava (People Ops): Home office reimbursements go to People Ops for policy check (eligible items, receipts, cost limits) then to payroll for payment. Did you use the "home-office" expense type and include invoice + proof of shipment?

Theo Ramos: Yes, used the portal expense type and attached the invoice and shipping confirmation. Request ID H-3321.

Ava (People Ops): I see H-3321  spending is within policy (monitor under $500). I approved it and forwarded to payroll. Liam, can you pick this up for the upcoming off-cycle?

Liam (Payroll): Yep  H-3321 queued for off-cycle payment 07/18. Expect payment by 07/19. It'll be paid as a taxable reimbursement per policy.

Theo Ramos: Amazing, appreciate the quick responses. Any action items for me?

Sanya (Benefits): Just keep an eye on the carrier confirmation email for spouse enrollment. If the carrier requests anything else I'll DM you.

Liam (Payroll): I'll confirm NY state withholding applied on 07/15 and DM you the confirmation. If any CA withholdings need reversal we'll coordinate.

Rita (HR Compliance): If you need the employer letter for state filing, request it after payroll confirms the withholding change and Ill issue it.

Theo Ramos: Will do. Thanks everyone! :tada:
